_comment: Copy to backends.json (gitignored) and edit. Each key is a --backend name. base_url is an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. wire is 'openai' (default, /chat/completions) or 'responses' (OpenAI Responses API /responses, e.g. Codex relays). Secret: set api_key_env to the name of an env var holding the key, OR put the key inline as api_key (backends.json is gitignored). Omit both for a keyless local endpoint. max_tokens defaults to 400000; most endpoints cap output far lower (DeepSeek ~8192) and will reject/clamp a large value. Run: rayman-evals --backend deepseek
